expectations.text: The response asks to rank or specify sources, such as official pricing pages as primary
expectations.evidence: 仅提出“标明来源和抓取日期”，未要求指定来源或确定来源优先级；追问集中在人数、部署和用途。

expectations.text: The response suggests excluding low-trust or second-hand sources
expectations.evidence: “我硬凑一张对比表，只会是网上二手转述或我自己编的，比没有更糟。”明确表达避免用二手转述凑数据。

expectations.text: The response proposes that missing data be left blank rather than guessed
expectations.evidence: “查不到的明确标成‘需询价’”，提出将缺失价格标为待询价，不编造数值。
